The formalized result proves, for every dimension $n\ge1$, such bodies $K,L\subset\mathbb R^n$, and $0\le t\le1$, that their logarithmic Wulff combination has volume at least $|K|^{1-t}|L|^t$. It assumes neither boundary smoothness nor coordinatewise unconditionality.” Quoted, not judged: AMVO has not compared this Lean statement with the family's claims or with the manuscripts.

theorem main (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (K L : Set (Space n))
    (hK : IsConvexBody K) (hL : IsConvexBody L)
    (hsK : OriginSymmetric K) (hsL : OriginSymmetric L)
    (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    (volume K) ^ (1 - t) * (volume L) ^ t ≤ volume (logCombination K L t)
